content:
The line from \(A'(-3,-9)\) to the circle center \((2,3)\) has direction vector \((5,12)\).  
Parametrize:
\[
(x,y)=(-3,-9)+t(5,12).
\]
It crosses the \(x\)-axis when \(y=0\):
\[
-9+12t=0 \Rightarrow t=\frac34.
\]
So
\[
P=\left(-3+5\cdot \frac34,0\right)=\left(\frac34,0\right).
\]

The shortest distance from \(A'\) to the circle is
\[
A'C - 1 = \sqrt{(2+3)^2+(3+9)^2}-1 = \sqrt{5^2+12^2}-1=13-1=12.
\]

Thus the shortest path length is
\[
\boxed{12}.
\]
